protocol.device: Apple M1 / ANGLE Metal / in-app browser
protocol.windows: Last ten ready two-second windows; both other previews idle for twelve windows
protocol.baselineSource: Unmodified git archive of baseline, regional=1 for transition on both sides
caveats: Sequential loads, online terrain and imagery cache can differ
GPU submission interval includes CPU waits; CPU measurements nest
Mixed species and constant native exaggeration can change triangles and terrain tiles
Mobile is quality budget on M1, not Android/iPhone hardware or phone viewport
Fixed-camera results do not certify full-flight frame pacing
